new_pending_page.title: Spawn child processes with windowsHide -> avoid console flash
new_pending_page.trigger: Calling child_process.spawn or execSync from a long-running Node process on Windows
new_pending_page.insight: Always set windowsHide:true so the brief console window does not flash; matters in polling loops
new_pending_page.summary: On Windows, every Node child_process call without windowsHide briefly flashes a console window. In polling loops or hooks that fire repeatedly the flash compounds into a UX bug. Pass {windowsHide:true} to spawn / execSync / spawnSync.
new_pending_page.pattern: Default Node child_process spawn shows a console window on Windows; setting windowsHide:true suppresses it. Required for any subprocess called from a daemon or scheduled task.
